name: DECALS J0542-2125 (Hubble)
blurb: DECALS J0542-2125, a pair of merging galaxy clusters, seen by Hubble.
label: decalsj05422125-hubble
story: Two galaxy clusters appear to be merging here, and their combined gravity bends the light of a distant quasar into three separate images. Hubble mapped this region to help chart where the dark matter, hot gas and stars lie.

claims.text: DECALS J0542-2125 is a candidate cluster merger: two galaxy clusters of comparable mass
The lensing cluster appears to be merging, with two sub-clusters
A distant quasar is lensed into three images by the cluster
The system is also called COOL J0542-2125 (and DECALS J0542-2125)
Hubble data constrain a lens model; the program maps dark matter, X-ray gas and stars
Archive target DECALSJ0542-2125-3 is a cluster-of-galaxies pointing at this position
